rationale: The description covers on-site emergency gateway management that updates phone locations and notifies security when 9-1-1 is dialed.
evidence_spans: Emergency Gateway (EGW) is an on-site appliance that streamlines E9-1-1 management.
It ensures that your IP phone locations'are updated and current and notifies on-site security personnel any time 9-1-1 is dialed from within your enterprise.
